schema: schema.json is byte-identical prior v1, no version bump

fields.mapping: exact integer token1; unknown scalar integer version → UnsupportedSchema
project_uuid; lowercase UUID-v4 wire check before PersistentProjectId::candidate (candidate alone not validation)
definition_revision.0; canonical decimal STRING0..18446744073709551615, no signs/leading zeros/JSON number
draft.name unchanged; raw1..120 Unicode chars plus existing domain trimmed-name validation; codec never trims/changes value
Draft/draft; Defined/defined. Defined alone does not prove completeness/approval/generation
ordered draft.requirements: id,intent,acceptance list,RequirementState; existing S1 ID validation
None/null or exact id/version/sourceDigest object, required nonempty id/version and digest syntax
approval_refs data IDs only; blank refs may remain draft/missing decisions, no authorization inferred
legacy_root_keys opaque portable IDs, no path/URI-like alias; do not rewrite original WORK/lease registration
BTreeMap ExtensionValue recursive; preserve keys/arrays/value semantics and exact Number token text

target_details.id: canonical UUID-v4, unique by existing S1 validator
target_details.toolchain: ordered strings; incomplete empty list accepted as draft

field_state.unresolved: value must be null; non-null payload cannot be dropped
field_state.tentative: value must be string, empty string allowed
field_state.confirmed: value must be string, empty string allowed and S1 may report generation missing
field_state.null_missing: required fields cannot be absent; null valid only where explicit wire schema permits

extension_mapping.Null/Bool/String: exact values; JSON string escape spelling may normalize semantically
extension_mapping.Object: BTreeMap key ordering deterministic; duplicates rejected even in extensions; literal serde-private-looking keys remain ordinary string keys
extension_mapping.Number(String): exact valid raw JSON numeric token, including -0/1.00/1E+03/big ints/decimals; never via f64 or serde_json::Value numeric conversion; invalid Number candidate rejected

feature_proposal.feature: raw_value only on HOST existing direct dependency
feature_proposal.implementation_boundary: HOST private raw DTO/children map RawValue text directly to existing ExtensionValue, duplicate-aware maps; no WORK serde or production helper service
feature_proposal.why: Preserve exact numeric token without arbitrary_precision global number behavior or new crate/version
feature_proposal.manifest_scope: HOST Cargo.toml only after approval; versions/checksums/all Cargo.lock protected; --locked tests in workspace+standalone shell
feature_proposal.local_primary_source: registry serde_json1.0.154 src/raw.rs says raw formatting retained; Cargo.toml raw_value=[]; static inspection only

limits_proposed.counting: root depth0/node1; every object/array/leaf counts1; keys not value nodes but count toward string bytes; total byte cap includes whitespace
limits_proposed.read_boundary: Current Port read/read_current read whole files. Cap is post-read/pre-parse, NOT bounded OS read/allocation. A bounded-read Port would require a separate proposal.

encoding: UTF8/noBOM; known fields in schema property order; 2-space pretty plus finalLF; extension objects sorted, arrays unchanged, Number token text exact. Semantic roundtrip, not full original raw formatting equality.
alias_policy: Only opaque non-path legacy IDs portable. Path/URI-like legacyRootKeys → InvalidPortableAlias; explicit omission by trusted adoption caller allowed, source WORK/leases unchanged. No automatic hash/remap. Root/session/window/import source path not serialized. Freeform purpose/extension text is not claimed to be secret-scrubbed.
approval_boundary: Decoded refs/defined mode are data; trusted generation approval resolution remains outside S2.
decode_validation_priority: existing domain validate_definition(draft) + portable alias guard
operation binding/expected digest/UUID/revision before first write
encode_validation_priority: wire-representable typed fields/UUID/revision/enums/FieldState/Number token + existing domain validation
resource guards, deterministic field and extension traversal
serialize deterministically, output cap → Codec.OutputTooLarge; no partial bytes returned
implementation_constraint: Bounded resource/duplicate-aware raw parsing precedes typed RawValue conversion. Do not use float-based intermediate values, default duplicate-last-wins maps, or serde-default recursion errors as fake resource guard evidence. Helpers remain private HOST implementation choices.
